title: Move the static site to the new host
intro: Copy the site to the new host and switch its name. Then check that nothing broke. This takes about 20 minutes.
before: **Tell the team.** Nobody publishes to the site during the move.

riskLegend.high: a mistake takes the site offline
riskLegend.med: a mistake shows old or wrong pages
riskLegend.low: a small follow-up after the move

detailsNote: Old host: old-host.example · New host: new-host.example
helperIntro: Use these commands in any area.
out: This walk does not test email or search ranking.

site-home.caption: Home page on the old host. Compare the header and the footer only.
site-home.alt: Site home page with a header, four text lines and a footer

outcomes.heading: Before you start
outcomes.hook: Record the old values before you change anything.
outcomes.note: Nothing changes in this area. These checks record the values that the undo commands need.

setupPoints.text: Sign in to the deploy account on both hosts.
Nothing changes in this area, so nothing needs putting back.

steps.displayAction: **Check the DNS record.** Read the address of the site name.
steps.displayMust: The command prints the old host address `192.0.2.10`.

detail.data: The site name is `www.example.org`. The old host address is `192.0.2.10`.

how.text: Compare the address with the old host address.

detail.expect: The command prints `192.0.2.10`. No other address shows.
detail.failure: The command prints another address or nothing. Stop and ask the site owner.
detail.why: Check B2 changes this record. The undo command of B2 needs the old value.

cleanup.text: This check only reads, so nothing needs undoing.

steps.displayAction: **Check the home page.** Open the site on the old host.
steps.displayMust: The home page shows its header, its text and its footer.

detail.data: The site is `www.example.org` on the old host. You enter no values.

how.text: Compare it with the reference screenshot.

detail.expect: The page shows the same header and footer as the reference screenshot.
detail.failure: The page is blank, shows an error, or has no footer.
detail.why: You compare the new host with this page in check C1.

cleanup.text: This check only reads, so nothing needs undoing.

outcomes.heading: Copy and switch
outcomes.hook: Copy the files, then point the name at the new host.
outcomes.note: Both checks change something. Each one has an undo command under Put it back.

diagrams.title: Move order
diagrams.caption: Copy the files first. The name moves only after the new host has every file.

setupPoints.text: Do this area only after A1 and A2 pass.
Run the undo commands from B2 back to B1.

steps.displayAction: **Copy the files.** Copy the site files to the new host.
steps.displayMust: `rsync` ends with a total size and no error.

detail.data: Source: the `public` folder of the site build. Target: `/srv/site` on `new-host.example`.
warnings: Check the target folder before you run `rsync --delete`.

how.text: Check that the last line shows a total size.

detail.expect: The last line shows a total size. No line starts with `rsync error`.
detail.failure: A line starts with `rsync error`, or the command stops early.
detail.why: The new host must have every file before the name points at it.

steps.displayAction: **Switch the name.** Point `www.example.org` at the new host.
steps.displayMust: The command prints the new host address `198.51.100.20`.

detail.data: New host address: `198.51.100.20`. Old host address: `192.0.2.10`. Time to live: 300 seconds.
detail.failure: The second command still prints `192.0.2.10` after five minutes.
detail.why: Visitors reach the new host only after the name points at it.

cleanup.text: Wait five minutes before you trust the old host again.

outcomes.heading: After the switch
outcomes.hook: Check the new host, now and at the next renewal.
outcomes.note: One check runs today. The other waits for the next certificate renewal.

setupPoints.text: Nothing changes in this area, so nothing needs putting back.

steps.displayAction: **Check the new host.** Open the site after the switch.
steps.displayMust: The home page loads from the new host.

detail.data: The site is `www.example.org` on the new host. You enter no values.

how.text: Compare it with the reference screenshot of check A2.

detail.expect: The server name is the new host. The page matches the reference screenshot.
detail.failure: The server name is the old host, or the page differs from check A2.
detail.why: This proves that visitors now reach the new host.

cleanup.text: This check only reads, so nothing needs undoing.

steps.displayAction: **Check the renewal.** Confirm that the new host renews its certificate.
steps.displayMust: The renewal log shows a new certificate.

detail.data: The renewal log is `/var/log/cert-renew.log` on the new host.

how.text: Do this check after the next renewal, not today.

detail.expect: The last lines show a new certificate with a later end date.
detail.failure: The log shows an error, or the end date did not change.
detail.why: A certificate that does not renew takes the site offline later.

cleanup.text: This check only reads, so nothing needs undoing.
